purpose: Record the clarified Simptomat design: adaptive symptom screening and differential-diagnostic reasoning occur in the same loop, while consented case accumulation forms a separate calibration/provenance loop.

reasoning_contract.initial_state: Maintain a broad admissible set of disease/syndrome hypotheses.
reasoning_contract.update: Each answer may support, weaken, contradict, or leave unresolved one or more candidates.
reasoning_contract.question_policy: Prefer questions with high discriminatory value among live candidates, except when urgent safety screening should override information gain.
reasoning_contract.ranking: Rank candidates using evidence states unless separately validated calibration supports numeric clinical probabilities.
reasoning_contract.falsification: Favored hypotheses must be exposed to questions or measurements that could weaken them.
reasoning_contract.measurement_handoff: When conversation is insufficient, identify an external examination/test/measurement capable of discriminating candidates.

founding_case_relationship.preservation_rule: The frozen founding protocol and founding case are not retroactively rewritten. The diagnostic-reasoning core clarifies project-wide semantics for current and future use.
